provenance.rankDefinition: Pregame model mean, all eligible observed-season identities; no outcome-based ranking
provenance.rankUniverse: Current-season observed identities, not an archived pregame roster/inactive universe. Conditional participation models lack historical injury/role inputs. Missing actuals remain counted, never silently set to zero.
provenance.cutoffRule: 2015–2025 plus 2026 weeks strictly before each target; features built only from that past dataset.
provenance.replayNote: Reconstructed weekly forecasts, not forecasts issued at the time. Week 1 uses prior-season usage; zero-history rookies use position priors. Week 5 saved forecasts are evaluated separately.
provenance.modelStatus: Isolated evaluation; production artifacts and approved model state unchanged
provenance.featureLimit: Inherited matchup-feature conventions; replay is an audit of the weekly model family, not a reconstruction of historical betting lines, roles or injury decisions.
provenance.actualHistory: ESPN player-card season history; all 80 current-roster player-week actuals available. Cohort missing coverage reported separately.
provenance.availabilityLimit: These compare conditional scoring forecasts with realized fantasy outcomes, including confirmed inactive zeros. Missing historical role/injury-probability inputs can cause availability misses rather than scoring-skill misses.
